events.title: Uncharted 1: Drake's Fortune is released
events.description: Uncharted 1 is released to the public.

events.title: Uncharted 2: Among Thieves is released
events.description: Uncharted 2 is released to the public. Bob Rafei, Erick Pangilinan and Toby Tobler left the studio after the release of Uncharted 1.

events.title: Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception is released
events.description: Uncharted 3 is released to the public. Bruce Straley, Dan Liebgold, Rob Adams, Judd Simantov and Rich Diamant left the studio after the release of Uncharted 2.

events.title: Uncharted: Golden Abyss is released for the PlayStation Vita.
events.description: Uncharted: Golden Abyss is released to the public for the PlayStation Vita. It was made by a different studio (Bend studio) with Amy Hennig, Game Director and Designer, as a Story Consultant.

events.title: Uncharted: Fight for Fortune is released for the PlayStation Vita.
events.description: Uncharted: Fight for Fortune is released to the public for the PlayStation Vita. It was made by a different studio (Bend studio) with Amy Hennig, Game Director and Designer, as a Story Consultant.

events.title: Uncharted: The Nathan Drake Collection is released.
events.description: Uncharted: The Nathan Drake Collection is a remastered collection of Drake's Fortune, Among Thieves and Drake's Deception. It was released to the public for the PlayStation 4.

events.title: Uncharted 4: A Thief's End is released
events.description: Uncharted 4 is released to the public. Amy Hennig, Richard Lemarchand, Pal-Kristian Engstad,Greg Edmonson, Bruce Swanson and Gordon Hunt left the studio after the release of Uncharted 3.

events.title: Uncharted: Fortune hunter is released
events.description: Uncharted: Fortune hunter is released to the public for mobile devices. It was made by a different studio (Playstation Mobile Inc.) with input from the Uncharted team at Naughty Dog.

events.title: Uncharted: The Lost Legacy is released
events.description: Uncharted: The Lost Legacy is released to the public. Jeremy Lai-Yates and Mike Hatfield left the studio after the relase of Uncharted 4.

events.title: Uncharted: Legacy of Thieves Collection is released.
events.description: Uncharted: Legacy of Thieves Collection is a remastered collection of Uncharted 4 and Uncharted: The Lost Legacy. It was released to the public for the PlayStation 5 and Windows by Naughty Dog and Iron Galaxy studios.

foundingMembers.name: David Jaffe
foundingMembers.position: Game Director / Lead Designer / Combat Scenarios / Writer

events.title: God of War is released
events.description: God of War is released to the public.

events.title: God of War II is released
events.description: God of War II is released to the public. 8 people left the studio after the release of God of War, including Terry Smith, Alexander Stein and Dave Matthews.

events.title: God of War: Betrayal is released
events.description: God of War: Betrayal is released to the public for mobile devices. It was made by a different studio (Javaground) with input from the God of War team at Sony Santa Monica.

events.title: God of War: Chains of Olympus is released
events.description: God of War: Chains of Olympus is released to the public for the PSP. It was made by a different studio (Ready at Dawn) with input from David Jaffe.

events.title: God of War Collection is released
events.description: God of War Collection is a remastered version of God of War 1 and 2. It was released to the public for the PlayStation 3 made by Bluepoint Games under supervision of Santa Monica studios.

events.title: God of War III is released
events.description: God of War III is released to the public. Around 5 people left the studio after the release of God of War II, including Shannon Studstill, Charlie Wen and David Jaffe.

events.title: God of War: Ghost of Sparta is released
events.description: God of War: Ghost of Sparta is released to the public for the PSP. It was made by a different studio (Ready at Dawn) with input from Cory Barlog.

events.title: God of War: Origins Collection is released
events.description: God of War: Origins Collection is released to the public for PS3 containing Chains of Olympus and Ghost of Sparta. It was made by a different studio (Ready at Dawn) with input from Santa Monica Studios.

events.title: God of War: Saga is released
events.description: God of War: Saga is released to the public containing remastered versions of the previous games. It was made by a different studio (Ready at Dawn and Bluepoint Games) with input from Santa Monica Studios.

events.title: God of War: Ascension is released
events.description: God of War: Ascension is released to the public. Around 4 people left the studio after the release of God of War III, including Cory Barlog, Steve Caterson and Allan Becker.

events.title: God of War: Collection is released
events.description: God of War: Collection is released to the public for PS Vita containing God of War I and II. It was made by a different studio (Sanzaru Games) with input from Santa Monica Studios.

events.title: God of War III Remastered is released
events.description: God of War III Remastered is a remastered version of God of War III. It was released to the public for the PlayStation 4 made by Wholesale Algorithms, INC. under supervision of Santa Monica studios.

events.title: God of War: A Call from the Wilds
events.description: God of War: A Call from the Wilds is released to the public in Facebook Messenger (I'm serious). It was made by Santa Monica Studios, there isn't much more information available.

events.title: God of War
events.description: God of War is released to the public. Around 5 people left the studio after the release of God of War: Ascension, including Marianne Krawczyk, Tim Moss and Christer Ericson. Cory Barlog returned to the studio as Creative Director and writer for this game.

events.title: God of War (PC) is released
events.description: God of War ported to pc. It was made by Jetpack Interactive under supervision of Santa Monica Studios.

events.title: God of War Ragnarok is released
events.description: God of War: Ragnarok is released to the public. Maximilian Vaughn Ancar left the studio after the release of God of War, the second last member of the original team.

events.title: God of War Ragnarok: Valhalla is released
events.description: God of War: Ragnarok is released to the public. A DLC for God of War: Ragnarok.

events.title: God of War Ragnarok + Valhalla(PC) is released
events.description: God of War ported to pc. It was made by Jetpack Interactive under supervision of Santa Monica Studios.

events.title: God of War Sons of Sparta is released
events.description: God of War Sons of Sparta is released to the public for the PlayStation 5. It was made by a different studio (Mega Cat Studios) with input from Santa Monica Studios.

events.title: God of War: Laufey is announced
events.description: God of War Laufey is announced to the public. It's gonna be made by Santa Monica Studios.

foundingMembers.name: Shauna Perry
foundingMembers.position: Director of Audio / Localization / External Resources

events.title: Dragon Age: Origins is released
events.description: Dragon Age: Origins is released to the public.

events.title: Dragon Age: Origins - Awakening is released
events.description: Dragon Age: Origins - Awakening is released to the public. An expansion pack for Dragon Age: Origins.

events.title: Dragon Age II is released
events.description: Dragon Age II is released to the public. Around 14 people left the studio after the release of Dragon Age: Origins, including Dan Tudge, James Ohlen and Brent Knowles.

events.title: Heroes of Dragon Age is released
events.description: Heroes of Dragon Age is released to the public. It was made by a different studio (Capital Games).

events.title: Dragon Age: Inquisition is released
events.description: Dragon Age: Inquisition is released to the public. Around 7 people left the studio after the release of Dragon Age II, including David Gaider, Mark Darrah and Mike Laidlaw.

events.title: Dragon Age: The Veilguard is released
events.description: Dragon Age: The Veilguard is released to the public. Around 5 people left the studio after the release of Dragon Age: Inquisition, including Shane Hawco, Ian Stubbington and Dave Hill.

foundingMembers.name: Sylvain Bernard
foundingMembers.position: Animation Director Crowd/Cinematics / Mocap Shoot Director / Mocap Actor

events.title: Assassin's Creed is released
events.description: Assassin's Creed is released to the public.

events.title: Assassin's Creed II is released
events.description: Assassin's Creed II is released to the public. Around 12 people left the studio after the release of Assassin's Creed, including Raphaël Lacoste, Maxime Béland and David Châteauneuf.

events.title: Assassin's Creed: Brotherhood is released
events.description: Assassin's Creed: Brotherhood is released to the public. Around 3 people left the studio after the release of Assassin's Creed II, including Jade Raymond, Alex Drouin and Dominic Couture.

events.title: Assassin's Creed: Revelations is released
events.description: Assassin's Creed: Revelations is released to the public. Around 5 people left the studio after the release of Assassin's Creed: Brotherhood, including Patrice Desilets, Sylvain Bernard and Mathieu Jeanson. Raphaël Lacoste returned for this release

events.title: Assassin's Creed III is released
events.description: Assassin's Creed III is released to the public. Only one person left the studio after the release of Assassin's Creed: Revelations, Jesper Kyd.

events.title: Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag is released
events.description: Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag is released to the public. Corey May, the last member of the original team, left the studio after the release of Assassin's Creed III. Raphaël Lacoste and Danny Oros returned for this release.

events.title: Assassin's Creed: Rogue is released
events.description: Assassin's Creed: Rogue is released to the public. There are no remaining members of the original team from the first game.

events.title: Assassin's Creed: Unity is released
events.description: Assassin's Creed: Unity is released to the public. There are no remaining members of the original team from the first game, Sylvain Bernard and Mathieu Jeanson returned for this release.

events.title: Assassin's Creed: Syndicate is released
events.description: Assassin's Creed: Syndicate is released to the public. There are no remaining members of the original team from the first game, Corey May returned for this release.

events.title: Assassin's Creed: Origins is released
events.description: Assassin's Creed: Origins is released to the public. There are no remaining members of the original team from the first game, Raphaël Lacost returned for this release.

events.title: Assassin's Creed: Odyssey is released
events.description: Assassin's Creed: Odyssey is released to the public. There are no remaining members of the original team from the first game.

events.title: Assassin's Creed: Valhalla is released
events.description: Assassin's Creed: Valhalla is released to the public. There are no remaining members of the original team from the first game, Raphaël Lacoste and Jesper Kyd returned for this release.

events.title: Assassin's Creed: Mirage is released
events.description: Assassin's Creed: Mirage is released to the public. There are no remaining members of the original team from the first game.

events.title: Assassin's Creed: Shadows is released
events.description: Assassin's Creed: Shadows is released to the public. There are no remaining members of the original team from the first game.

events.title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag: Resynced is released
events.description: Assassin's Creed Black Flag: Resynced is released to the public. Information in progress.
